greet.text: Mind your step on the forest road, {player}. I lead the village hunt each season; the boars do not care whether you cultivate or not.

choices.label: How does the village hunt work?

friend.text: {player}! Good. A steady arm is worth more than a clever tongue when a stag is charging. Sit, the venison is nearly done.

choices.label: How does the village hunt work?

hunt.text: Each season, on the first market day, we ride out after whatever runs fat in Misty Forest: the stag in spring, the boar in summer, the fox in autumn, the wolf in winter. Join us, and the beast's spoils come doubled.

lesson.text: Hm. Fists first. A blade can break; a hand does not. Feet apart. Elbow in. Breathe out when you strike. Not like that. Again.

spar.text: Again. A fist that lands once is luck. Land it ten times and it is a habit. Rest your arm; the boar will not.

advice.text: Listen for the birds. When they stop all at once, something big is walking. Better to be downwind of it, and better still to be somewhere else.
